lines.text: Many learners say: I and my friend went to the park.
Better: My friend and I went to the park.
My brother and I! My brother and I went to the beach.

data.wrong: I and my friend went to the park.
data.right: My friend and I went to the park.

native.tip: 한국어 “나와 친구는”처럼 나를 먼저 말하는 순서를 그대로 옮기기 쉬워요. 영어는 상대를 먼저 말해 My friend and I라고 해요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My friend and I went to the park.”

en.tip: Say the other person before I. Say “My friend and I went to the park.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I and my friend went to the park.” Say the other person before I. Right: “My friend and I went to the park.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
